headline: Weathered Expanse Stlican Shelf Drive Frontline Surge
war_summary: Since the 15:15 edition the war has sharpened on a handful of sectors. Weathered Expanse now records six ownership changes in the last two hours and sixty‑five in the past day; colonial and warden casualties are both surging (≈1,080 and 1,260 per hour) while fresh enlistments climb sharply. Stlican Shelf shows eleven flips in the last six hours and fifty‑three daily, with casualties accelerating on both sides (≈59 and 81 per hour) and enlistments rising. Stonecradle adds three flips in two hours and fourteen daily; casualties are accelerating (≈454 colonial, 589 warden per hour) and enlistments increase. Linn Mercy logs three recent flips and fifteen daily; casualties have cooled on both windows but enlistments are picking up. Callahan’s Passage remains a blood‑bath with fifteen daily flips, massive and accelerating casualties (≈1,030 colonial, 810 warden per hour) and a surge of new troops. Dead Lands has gone quiet in the last two hours but still posted fourteen daily flips; warden losses stay high while colonial losses accelerate modestly. The remaining regions stay largely static with negligible events and low, stable casualties.
